mapper.select: SELECT VENDOR_CODE , VENDOR_ID , SEQ , NAME_KOR , NAME_ENG , POSITION , EMAIL , TEL_NO , REMARK FROM VENDOR_IN_CHARGE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND VENDOR_CODE = #{vc_code} ORDER BY SEQ

SELECT CUSTOMER_CODE AS VC_CODE , CUSTOMER_NAME AS VC_NAME , CUSTOMER_NAME_ENG AS VC_NAME_ENG , BUSINESS_NO , OFFICER_NAME , OFFICER_NAME_ENG , NATION_CODE , ADDRESS , ADDRESS_ENG , TEL_NO , FAX_NO , TARGET_YN AS MGT_YN , CO_CERTIFIED_EXPORTER_YN , REMARK , DELETE_YN FROM CUSTOMER WHERE 1 = 1
AND (CUSTOMER_CODE LIKE CONCAT(#{searchCode}, '%') OR CUSTOMER_NAME LIKE CONCAT(#{searchCode}, '%'))
AND TARGET_YN = #{searchMgtYn}
ORDER BY CUSTOMER_CODE
